title: Ulu Maika
tagline: Sight the lane, set the lean, swipe to roll: thread the stakes.
description: The disc-rolling game of Hawaiʻi. Look down a sunny meadow lane, turn the sight, bow the roll with a lean and swipe to send a smooth stone disc between the gate stakes and on to the far stake. Slopes push, mud drags, boulders bar the way. Five rivals, pass-and-play, solo practice.
howToPlay: Drag the picture to turn the sight.
Set a lean to curve the roll left or right.
Press ROLL, swipe up and let go: farther is harder.
Pass clean between the gate stakes, then finish at the far stake.
Most points after all discs wins.
